name: mail.status
description: Classify one job-search email thread (subject + first message + latest message) into the pipeline event it represents, the company, and the role. Deterministic code cannot do this reliably from ATS boilerplate.

event.instructions: What this thread most recently represents in the candidate's pipeline

criteria.application_received: Automated acknowledgment that an application was received or is under review; no decision
criteria.rejected: The employer declined to move forward, chose another candidate, closed or filled the role, or said the profile is not a match
criteria.interview_invite: An invitation, scheduling request, confirmation, reminder or calendar item for a screen or interview
criteria.assessment: A take-home, HackerRank or other assessment step
criteria.advance: Explicit notice the candidate is moving to a next round after a conversation
criteria.recruiter_outreach: An inbound recruiter or search-firm approach not tied to an application the candidate submitted
criteria.candidate_sent: A message the candidate himself sent (thank-you, follow-up, reply)
criteria.other: Portal task, security code, digest, or unrelated

stage_reached.instructions: Furthest stage evidenced anywhere in the thread

criteria.recruiter_screen: A recruiter or coordinator screen was held or scheduled
criteria.hiring_manager: A hiring-manager or panel conversation was held or scheduled

explicit_reason.instructions: The employer states a concrete reason for its decision rather than boilerplate

role_is_leadership.instructions: The role named in the thread is Director, Senior Director, VP, Head-of, Executive Director, Chief, or Principal/Distinguished level

role_is_hands_on_ic.instructions: The role named in the thread is an individual-contributor engineering, architect, or developer seat

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for the Gmail pipeline audit. No rules: this is a pure classifier consumed by code.
